desc:
Meet Verity, your friendly building assistant!

This game is a demo and may contain a few bugs. 
There will also be many updates in the future!
Inspired by ThatMob’s original Verity series.

✨ Create anything you can imagine
🏗️ Build with the help of Verity
💬 Talk with Verity and describe your ideas
🌎 Turn your imagination into reality

What will you build with Verity?
